goal: Keep DC-Agent skill preloading compatible with Agent Skills-style SKILL.md packages while bounding referenced context and preventing path escape reads.

acceptance_criteria.description: DC-Agent discovers skill directories that contain SKILL.md, parses their frontmatter, and preloads matched SKILL.md content into the skill prompt block.
Agent Skills-style optional references/*.md files linked from the same skill's SKILL.md are preloaded with the skill card.
Preloaded SKILL.md and references/*.md content remains bounded by the skill-card and prompt byte budgets.
Reference links that resolve outside the current skill directory are blocked and never injected into the preloaded skill card.
Contract coverage stays executable through this harness contract test and the focused tests/test_skill_loader.py checks.

DC-Agent installs the pure Obsidian authoring Agent Skills obsidian-markdown, obsidian-bases, and json-canvas, while leaving execution-oriented obsidian-cli and defuddle out of the runtime skill set until explicit execution policy exists.
Pure Obsidian authoring skills bypass business intent allowlists only through the bounded global authoring-skill policy when their own skill matcher succeeds.
Bundled Obsidian skills are versioned under bundled/skills and installed into ignored runtime data/skills by scripts/sync_bundled_skills.py without deleting unrelated runtime skills.

compatibility_rules.package_root: Each skill package is a directory containing SKILL.md.
compatibility_rules.optional_references: SKILL.md may link to markdown files under the same skill directory, including references/*.md.
compatibility_rules.bounded_references: Only a bounded subset of same-skill markdown references may be preloaded, and prompt assembly must still obey the configured byte budget.
compatibility_rules.path_boundary: Resolved reference paths must remain inside the current skill directory; parent traversal, absolute escapes, remote URLs, and self-links are ignored.

verification.focused_all: uv run pytest tests/test_sync_bundled_skills.py tests/test_skill_loader.py tests/test_skill_preloader.py tests/harness/test_agent_skill_compatibility_contract.py -q
